name: Particle flow comet
looks: Over a dark, dotted field with a faint flowing vector pattern, a comet of coloured dots traces a looping path, such as a figure-eight, its tail tapering away in size and opacity as it carries a labelled idea through the frame.
build: Drive the comet's head along a parametric loop (for example, sines at different frequencies on each axis) from the master clock, trailing a tail of its last few positions at falling size and opacity, over a faint field of short seeded flow-vector strokes.
prompt: Trace a looping comet of small coloured dots across a dark, faintly flowing field, its tail fading away behind it, to carry a single idea through a transition or a quieter connecting beat without needing a large particle set piece.
